# TPC-DI A5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT c.Country, c.StateProv, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SK_CustomerID) AS customer_count, COUNT(t.TradeID) AS trade_count, SUM(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value, AVG(c.NetWorth) AS avg_net_worth FROM DimCustomer AS c LEFT JOIN FactTrade AS t ON c.SK_CustomerID = t.SK_CustomerID WHERE c.IsCurrent IS TRUE GROUP BY c.Country, c.StateProv HAVING customer_count > 10 ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 50
```
